Vicar of St.

Peter’s, Plymouth

He served from 16 Aug 1848 to his death as Vicar of St.

Peter's, Plymouth; he married (17 April 1849) Emily Fellowes (d. 1901).

He was an enthusiastic Tractarian much involved in religious rows in Plymouth.
